rationale_code: `brave_web_search` is advertised unconditionally in `ListTools` and calls Brave's fixed web search endpoint. It sets the user-supplied `query` as Brave API parameter `q`, fetches from `https://api.search.brave.com/res/v1/web/search`, and returns web result `title`, `description`, and `url` as text.

`brave_local_search` is advertised unconditionally in `ListTools` and calls fixed Brave Search API endpoints for location lookup, POI details, and descriptions.
